name: KTM 250 / 300 two-stroke enduro
engine: 249 or 293 cc liquid-cooled two-stroke single, carb or TPI fuel injection
intro: KTM's two-stroke enduro bikes. Carb on older bikes, TPI fuel injection from 2018.

add.title: Check compression and the top end
add.instructions: Do a compression test. Low numbers mean the piston and rings are due. Clean the power valve while you are in there.
add.reason: A tired top end and a gummed power valve are the most common problems on a used two-stroke.

B: Carbureted bikes run on premix. TPI bikes have an oil tank and injection. Check which you have before you fill up.

recallNote: KTM has issued recalls on some bikes in these years. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls before you start.
